sloka: गोपुराट्टप्रतोलीषु चर्यासु विविधासु च।प्रासादेषु च संहृष्टाः ससृजुस्ते हुताशनम्।तेषां गृहसस्राणि ददाह हुतभुक् तदा ।। ६.७५.६ ।।
transliteration: gopurāṭṭapratolīṣu caryāsu vividhāsu ca।prāsādeṣu ca saṁhṛṣṭāḥ sasṛjuste hutāśanam।teṣāṁ gṛhasasrāṇi dadāha hutabhuk tadā ।। 6.75.6 ।।

translations.english: Rejoiced Vanaras set fire to the towering gates, attics, different streets as well as mansions to send away Rakshasas.
